# opnsense_trafficshaper_pipe (Data Source)

Traffic shaper pipes limit the total bandwidth available to the traffic sent into them, either directly by a rule or through queues.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth` (Number) Total bandwidth of the pipe, in `bandwidth_metric` units.
- `bandwidth_metric` (String) Unit of `bandwidth`: `bit`, `Kbit`, `Mbit` or `Gbit` (per second).
- `buckets` (Number) Number of hash buckets for dynamic queues.
- `codel_ecn_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, CoDel marks packets with ECN instead of dropping them.
- `codel_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, CoDel active queue management is used. Cannot be combined with `pie_enable`.
- `codel_interval` (Number) CoDel interval in milliseconds.
- `codel_target` (Number) CoDel target queue delay in milliseconds.
- `delay` (Number) Added delay in milliseconds.
- `description` (String) Description of the pipe. Queues and rules refer to the pipe by UUID, the GUI shows this text.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this entry is enabled.
- `fqcodel_flows` (Number) FQ-CoDel number of flows.
- `fqcodel_limit` (Number) FQ-CoDel queue limit in packets.
- `fqcodel_quantum` (Number) FQ-CoDel quantum in bytes.
- `mask` (String) Create a dynamic queue per address: `none`, `src-ip`, `dst-ip`, `src-ip6` or `dst-ip6`. Masking by source or destination shares the bandwidth per host instead of across all traffic.
- `number` (Number) Number OPNsense assigned to the pipe (ipfw pipe number).
- `pie_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, PIE active queue management is used. Cannot be combined with `codel_enable`.
- `queue` (Number) Queue size in slots.
- `scheduler` (String) Scheduler type: `fifo`, `rr` (deficit round robin), `qfq`, `fq_codel` (FlowQueue-CoDel) or `fq_pie` (FlowQueue-PIE). Leave unset for weighted fair queueing.
